name: Obinna Halvorsen-Tran
description: Obinna Halvorsen-Tran dominated the Synapse Slam Continental circuit for eight years between 2192 and 2200, a Nigerian-Norwegian-Vietnamese hybrid sport athlete whose combination of physical chrome — subdermal impact plating, hydraulic knee augmentation — and an exceptionally refined combat-BCI made him the first fighter to win three consecutive Continental titles in the neural-physical division. He retired at thirty-one following a spinal cascade incident during the 2200 championship final that left him with permanent lateral nerve damage, and his post-retirement advocacy for Synapse Slam safety reforms has been both celebrated and aggressively litigated by the league's corporate sponsors.
story_hooks: Halvorsen-Tran is approached by a current Synapse Slam fighter who wants to testify anonymously about league-mandated BCI overclocking — but fears retaliation against their family in Tier 1.
The spinal cascade that ended his career may not have been an accident; a recently retired league official is willing to talk, but only in person and only once.

His safety reform foundation is running out of funding after a coordinated corporate donor withdrawal; someone is offering a significant anonymous donation, and the strings attached are not immediately visible.
